hooks.command: dir=$(jq -r '.cwd // ""'); notify-send -a 'Claude Code' 'Claude Code' "Finished in ${dir##*/}"; bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/speak-notify.sh" /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga "Finished in ${dir##*/}" &

json=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); cwd="${cwd:-$PWD}"; root=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$cwd"); name="${root##*/}"; orig=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r '.message // "needs your input"'); first=$(printf '%s' "$orig" | sed -E 's/([.!?]).*/\1/'); msg="$name needs your input: $first"; notify-send -a 'Claude Code' 'Claude Code' "$name needs your input: $orig"; bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/speak-notify.sh" /usr/share/sounds/deepin/stereo/dialog-error.wav "$msg" &
